newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stocks stuck on Telefonica, seen brightening.
newsitem.headline: Madrid stocks stuck on Telefonica, seen brightening.

text.p: Madrid stocks stumbled in late trade on Friday, quoting nearly flat in the indices, as Telefonica losses held back other shares from following the trend on foreign markets.
Dealers said the setback was temporary and expected a recovery in the short term.
The general index fell 0.25 points, 0.07 percent, to 370.90 and the Ibex-35 lost 4.41 points, 0.1 percent, to 4,243.07.
Telefonica shed 30 pesetas, 1.22 percent, to 2,435 with some 3.4 million shares traded on news of a possible share offer at the start of the year.
"Some dealers have taken advantage of the news to make a profit on the share," one dealer said.
Total trading volume reached more than 40.5 billion pesetas.

"The descent in Telefonica weighed on the market most of the session, but in other groups like electricity shares there was a lot of interest and at a general level, we'll see gains in the short term," another dealer said.
